scope: independent retained-capture replay; no timing child or Cargo execution

replayed.statistics: recomputed per child from retained sorted raw elapsed vectors using floored midpoint p50 and nearest-rank p95/p99; retained verification summaries match exactly
replayed.custody: all 18 child receipts, command receipts, report/evidence/stdout/stderr descriptors, binary identities, plan hashes, and aligned sample-index vectors matched their retained files
replayed.ordering: all child intervals were sequential and the native lane finished before allocator began
replayed.semantic_replay: archive, oracle, counts, source-version fences, route flags, producer sidecar census, native RSS scope, allocator zero-failure and positive-primary metrics passed

guards: requires build.json, verification.json, capture-review.json, and source-archive-replay.json status pass
reloads and validates frozen plan before removal
requires non-symlink ownership markers .owner-0885 with exact content
checks retained source manifest/archive, binaries, depfiles, build receipts/logs, and manifest membership of every dependency
removes only the two owned source/build directories and records retained archive/binaries

caveats: The capture remains a descriptive warm-cache baseline with CPU affinity and no exclusive-host guarantee; the replay does not create a comparison or speedup claim.
Cleanup.py was inspected with AST and source checks only; root must execute it after this pass and retain its cleanup.json receipt.
